fact: The Independent Electoral Commission says the definitive 2024-2025 voters' roll of 8,727,431 electors is a biometric file, whose biometrics stop remaining imperfections from affecting the integrity of the vote.
The Independent Electoral Commission says the definitive roll can be consulted from 4 June 2025 on its website and by SMS using the codes *919# or #919# on all mobile operators.
The CEI said the 2024-2025 provisional electoral list of 8,761,348 voters was ready after enrolment on tablets, and handed parties a copy on USB.
The CEI said the provisional list would be displayed at enrolment centres from 17 to 21 March 2025, opening claims and objections from 22 March.
